tools.name: search_taxonomy
tools.description: Use this to find goods and services for a China trademark filing by keyword, in English or Chinese, optionally within one class. Items come from the current list of CNIPA (China National Intellectual Property Administration), maintained by Ginbing. labelZh is the exact Chinese text filed with CNIPA,

tools.name: validate_taxonomy_items
tools.description: Use this to check that goods or services picked earlier are still on the current CNIPA list. Pass each itemId. To also check a saved filing, add previousFiling with the classNumber, groupCode, groupLabelZh, itemCode, labelZh and standardItem received for that item. status is current; needs_reselecti

tools.name: list_filing_drafts
tools.description: List the trademark application drafts in the connected Ginbing account, newest first.

tools.name: create_filing_draft
tools.description: Start a new trademark application draft in the connected Ginbing account. Reuse the same creationKey when retrying; the existing draft is returned. The customer completes and submits the application on the Ginbing website.

tools.name: get_filing_draft
tools.description: Read a draft with the fields still missing (missingFields, which you can fill with update_filing_draft) and the steps the customer completes on the Ginbing website (customerWebsiteSteps). Identity document numbers and documents stay on the website. When aiPreparationComplete is true, give the custom

tools.name: update_filing_draft
tools.description: Patch permitted fields of your draft using its expectedRevision. Omitted fields are preserved; null clears permitted text fields. Add goods/services with account-bound selection tokens from search_taxonomy, remove existing item IDs. Never supply external labels/classes or identity numbers. Outdated

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "update_filing_draft" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
